sentence: A study is coded as measuring competitive advantage only when it measures a distinct construct, such as a validated competitive-advantage scale or genuinely competitor-comparative evidence; a performance gain alone is coded as performance.
passage: [Chatterjee et al. (2021), p. 209] "Competitive advantage is the degree to which the performance of an organization working in the B2B context could achieve greater benefits compared to other organizations functioning in similar conditions."

gemini.overclaim: A study is coded as measuring competitive advantage only when it measures a distinct construct, such as a validated competitive-advantage scale; a performance gain alone is coded as performance
gemini.note: The passage supports the requirement for competitor-comparative evidence by defining competitive advantage as relative to other organizations, but it does not mention study coding rules, validated scales, or how to code performance gains alone.
